label: official-code, Blackwell-compatible deps + FFCV, seed0

progress_read_retry.interpretation: A single partial or transient progress.json read cannot terminate the unattended hook.

staleness_detection.interpretation: STALLED_SUSPECTED is a durable diagnostic, never a FAILED verdict. Progress age and the freshest live heartbeat must both exceed the threshold.

retryable_failures: resource gate below minimum free memory
CUDA out of memory during endpoint evaluation or independent replay

endpoint.dataset: official ordered torchvision CIFAR-10 test set
endpoint.input_pipeline: uint8 pixels -> CUDA float16 -> torchvision Normalize using official mean/std

rehearsal_failure_policy: Record REHEARSAL_FAILED and continue watching. Retry every 10 minutes. Final landing independently validates all 13 identity chains and may proceed without a successful rehearsal.

asymmetric_reproduction_gate.seed0_inside_standard_accuracy_interval: one successful run supports the existential statement that the released pipeline can reproduce the reported SA within tolerance; seed1 is not required for that statement
asymmetric_reproduction_gate.seed0_outside_standard_accuracy_interval: the result is per-run only and automatically requires one frozen seed1 reproduction before any pipeline-level failure wording
asymmetric_reproduction_gate.two_registered_failures: only if both seed0 and seed1 miss the same frozen ordered-test SA interval may the paper use pipeline-level wording, scoped to the two disclosed compatibility reproductions
asymmetric_reproduction_gate.unchanged_endpoint: epoch130 ordered full-test SA plus independently replayed official PGD50; thresholds remain frozen

final_sequence: validate supervisor PASSED and all 13 immutable checkpoint/metrics/telemetry records
validate epoch130 checkpoint and final route telemetry identities
run ordered full-test SA and official-semantics PGD50
independently replay every stored attack endpoint through the full routed model
apply the frozen SA and PGD50 interpretation rules without changing thresholds
write B1_LANDED_summary.json and a tracked Markdown report
commit and push only the two generated landing records on the feature branch
failure_policy: fail closed, preserve failure and retry-attempt artifacts under the run root, never call STALLED_SUSPECTED a failure, and do not commit or push partial landing output
